articles.title: 4 Penny Coffins Lets You Play 19th-Century Detective – Or a 10-Foot Demon Ripping Friends in Half
articles.summary: Other Ocean’s 4 Penny Coffins blends Among Us with Jack the Ripper in an 1888 Whitechapel social investigation game featuring 8-player and solo modes.
body: 4 Penny Coffins is Jack the Ripper Meets Among Us, with a little bit of Psychonauts thrown in for fun. In the upcoming social investigation game, up to 8 players hunt a hidden murderer through lies, shifting alibis, and hard evidence. One of the players is the Ripper, a “gleeful demon concealed behind a facade of humanity,” stalking the winding alleys and rotting byways of 1888 London.

Ahead of IGN debuting 4 Penny Coffins’s gameplay teaser during gamescom 2026, which you can see in the player below, I spoke to Other Ocean Interactive Marketing Manager Jared Petty about the game’s mechanics, unique style (think stylized gore on top of monochromatic photographs), and Tim Schafer-inspired humor.

“It's a goddamn blast,” Petty says. “Four Penny Coffins; I've rarely had more fun playing a game with other people. A long time ago I was talking to Tim Schafer and I was asking him about humor in video games. Tim's opinion is that humor in video games is the easiest thing in the world because to paraphrase, ‘Our medium was built on a little yellow man that eats dots being chased by ghosts.’
points: Other Ocean’s 4 Penny Coffins blends Among Us with Jack the Ripper in an 1888 Whitechapel social investigation game featuring 8-player and solo modes.

articles.title: The Pokémon Company on PokémonXP's Lottery System, Long Lines, and Limited Access to Workshops
articles.summary: About 50,000 people are attending PokémonXP and the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in San Francisco, California. Despite the huge turnout, The Pokémon Company International is aware of the disappointment among fans who either weren’t chosen for particular exclusive activities, or for tickets to…
body: This year, demand far outnumbered supply, Brown said, with more than 130,000 people throwing their names into the hat for a 3-day or single-day badge to PokémonXP – more than twice the number of people who’d be granted entrance, which also includes competitors and their families.
“Basically, anytime your demand well outstrips your supply, the sort of interest list into lottery is the only real way you can handle that,” Brown said.

Brown described that this is true across the events industry, and if it were set up as a “first come, first serve” online purchasing system, the system would crash and people would error out, making it a worse experience for fans that’s basically a random chance, anyway.

“The only thing I can do from an event operator's perspective is think about, how do we increase supply over time? From a system's perspective, there's honestly not a better system [than interest list into lottery] for that.”

articles.title: Harry Potter Meets The Odyssey in the Most Highly-Anticipated Fantasy Book of the Summer
articles.summary: Disney thinks it’s found the next Harry Potter. Last year, the company announced it had acquired the movie rights to Katherine Rundell’s Impossible Creatures series, noting that Rundell is the first author since J.K. Rowling to top the children’s bestseller lists in both the U.S. and U.K.
body: Released in 2023, Impossible Creatures introduced the hidden world of the Glimouria Archipelago, where mythological creatures still roam free. Like Narnia or Neverland, it’s a wondrous and dangerous realm for a young British kid to explore. Rundell based the stories in part on her childhood in Harare, Zimbabwe, where her father was a diplomat. She fuses her love of real animals with mythology and Shakespeare.

The first book is based primarily on The Odyssey, the second on Hamlet. The Neverfear is Die Hard with a Vengeance melded with the Labours of Hercules. Christopher Forester, a boy with a powerful connection with animals, takes care of all manner of mythical creatures on the island of Glimt with the help of the former pirate Nighthand and the scholar Irian Guinne. When Irian is abducted, Christopher and the former princess Anya are tasked with gathering rare components from magical creatures scattered around the archipelago to meet the demands of her captors.

articles.title: Anno 117's New Hippodrome DLC Is More Fun Than It Has Any Right to Be
articles.summary: Historically, middle-of-the-season DLC in Anno games tends to be weaker than what you'd get at the start or end. It's something for later expansions to build on, not necessarily an exciting addition in itself.
body: of the DLC is that it unlocks a new research branch that lets you build the Hippodrome. Historically in Byzantium and Rome, these buildings had immense, multi-layered political significance. Nobles and commoners would be in the same space for the same purpose (watching chariot races). The emperor would frequently use the location for ceremonies, executions, and other big state events. Anno 117 's Hippodrome DLC doesn't add executions, so this one's just for chariot racing. Well, not just for chariot racing, but I'll get to that shortly. The pomp surrounding it is just as important as the real historical thing, though.

articles.title: GTA 6 Will Have No Microtransactions or Generative AI at Launch, Rockstar Says
articles.summary: Rockstar Games has said Grand Theft Auto 6 will have no microtransactions or generative AI when it launches in November. The studio behind GTA 6 confirmed this year's monumental open-world game will dodge two potentially controversial practices during a conversation with Kinda Funny Games earlier…
body: Kinda Funny's Andy Cortez said he asked Rockstar if players will be able to use real-world money to purchase things in-game during a preview event that preceded the GTA 6: Extended Look. He went on, saying, "no monetizations in this game."
The site's Greg Miller immediately followed that topic, saying he asked Rockstar "point-blank" if there is generative AI in GTA 6. The team told him that there is "no AI" used in the game.

From Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 to Arc Raiders, generative AI has proven time and time again to be an especially troublesome element for developers to include in their games. The millions of gamers who have waited 13 years for the next Grand Theft Auto might be pleased to hear similar claims won't mar its mid-November release date. The issue of microtransactions, however, does come with a few things worth noting.

articles.title: Robert Downey Jr's 98-Minute Cult Classic Psychological Thriller Is Officially Coming to Netflix
articles.summary: Two decades ago, Robert Downey Jr. was who you hired if you wanted a memorably weird performance. Before his career renaissance in 2008 as the face of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Downey was a quirky character actor with a history of idiosyncratic roles.
body: In retrospect, however, 2003's Gothika is a weird little freak era for almost every actor in it. Halle Berry headlines as a prison psychiatrist who wakes up as an inmate in one of her own observation cells, but she's only one of a cast of characters who all come off like they're at least a little insane, no matter what side of the cell door they’re on. If that sounds like your sort of jam, Gothika is coming to Netflix on Sept. 1.

Dr. Miranda Grey (Berry) works with inmates at a penitentiary in Connecticut, including Chloe (Penélope Cruz), an inmate who had a psychotic break after killing her stepfather. On her way home after work, Miranda swerves to avoid a girl on the road and crashes her car.

Three days later, she wakes up in her own prison, where her colleague Pete Graham (Downey) reveals her husband Doug (Charles Dutton) has been murdered. Miranda is the only suspect, but she has no memory of what's happened and she's suddenly suffering from what may or may not be hallucinations of the girl from the road. Then it turns out Chloe might not be as far removed from reality as Miranda thought she was.

body: In television, there’s a similar scenario playing out, with multi-season shows like The Last of Us and Fallout enjoying remarkable success on streaming platforms. ( Fallout ’s third season recently began filming.) It’s clearly a great time to bring beloved gaming properties to other forms of media, especially with such a huge backlog to consider. Here are 12 games that deserve movie or TV adaptations sooner rather than later.

Diablo has been around for a long time, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version of Diablo 4 rumored to be on its way. The series keeps going strong because its themes resonate as much today as they ever did. There’s a lot of powerful imagery that would translate perfectly to a Hollywood blockbuster, whether the setting remained historical or developed into something more modern, like End of Days. The games themselves already provide a glimpse of the cinematic appeal the franchise offers. Throw in an endearing few protagonists embarking on a quest against the ultimate evil and you have the basis for a rousing good time.

Mayday is described as an action comedy film set during the height of the Cold War. It stars Ryan Reynolds as a a hot-shot U.S. Navy Pilot known as Lieutenant Troy "Assassin" Kelly who gets stranded behind enemy lines. He's discovered by ex-KGB agent Nikolai Ustinov (Kenneth Branagh), who just so happens to hold a certain reverence for American culture. The result is an unlikely buddy spy movie that looks to mix action with comedy.
If the trailer isn't enough of a preview for you, you can also check out IGN's exclusive clip from the film for additional details.

articles.title: Peter Cullen, voice of Optimus Prime in The Transformers, dies aged 85
articles.summary: Jody's first computer was a Commodore 64, so he remembers having to use a code wheel to play Pool of Radiance. A former music journalist who interviewed everyone from Giorgio Moroder to Trent Reznor, Jody also co-hosted Australia's first radio show about videogames,
body: In his review of Transformers: War for Cybertron, Dan Stapleton referred to "the tingly nerd-joy of hearing original Optimus Prime voice actor Peter Cullen's authoritative dialogue". Every time the character appeared on screen, as he did many times in videogames like Transformers: Devastation and Fall of Cybertron or the middling movies, it was thrilling to hear him and realize, yes, they got the "real" Optimus Prime.

As noted by The Hollywood Reporter, Cullen has died at the age of 85. He joins a string of particularly beloved celebrities to have died in recent days, including Dolly Parton, Yayoi Kusama, and Red Alert 3 star and camp icon Tim Curry.

While most famous for his recurring role as Optimus Prime, Cullen also voiced Venger in Dungeons & Dragons, Eeyore in Winnie the Pooh, Monterey Jack in Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers, and provided the menacing clicking sounds for the Predator.

articles.title: PSA: Swap the radial ability menu in Star Wars Zero Company for more of a trad XCOM-style experience
articles.summary: Jody's first computer was a Commodore 64, so he remembers having to use a code wheel to play Pool of Radiance. A former music journalist who interviewed everyone from Giorgio Moroder to Trent Reznor, Jody also co-hosted Australia's first radio show about videogames,
body: Star Wars Zero Company is enough like XCOM that everyone's been calling it ZCOM, but there are some ways it isn't quite XCOM enough for me. For starters, the radial menu you use to select each character's actions, a controller-friendly system that flings all your abilities out in a circle around the active character like a medieval jailer's ring of keys.

The first time I panned over to find an enemy I wanted to attack and then had to pan back to the character I'd selected to pick an attack off their radial menu I found myself wishing for a more traditional way to play. And look at that, there it is in the options menu. Go to the Gameplay section, scroll down to Ability Selection Style at the bottom of the General area, and bump it from Radial over to Linear.

That puts moving and shooting and overwatching and etcetera onto a numbered row of boxes down the bottom of the screen where God intended, getting them out of the way when you're trying to line up the perfect angle to punch someone into a wall from. There's also a Hybrid option if you're indecisive and feeling a bit "¿Por qué no los dos?"

articles.title: Dragon Ball Free-To-Play MOBA Announces Major "Overhaul" Ahead Of First Anniversary
articles.summary: "This was not a decision made lightly". The free-to-play MOBA game Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra celebrates its second anniversary in September, and to mark this occasion, Bandai Namco has provided a development update.
body: The big news is the game will be getting a major update, "or rather overhaul" that makes significant gameplay changes, steering it in a new direction. The reason behind the changes are due to the "high barrier to competitive play" and wanting to make the game more accessible to wider audiences for "years to come".
Since its conception, GEKISHIN SQUADRA's goal was to be an experience where players could enjoy Dragon Ball team battles anytime, anywhere, and with anyone.
However, over time, we found that the game's strategic depth and knowledge-based mechanics often created a large cap between the top performing players and everyone else in terms of game literacy.
As a result, new players often encountered lopsided matches and a high barrier to competitive play, leading to a gameplay experience that did not fully meet their expectations.

articles.title: A native port of Donkey Kong 64 is finally playable on PC thanks to a team of programmers who boast that 'no generative AI [was] used at any point in the process'
articles.summary: A native PC port of Nintendo's 1999 platformer Donkey Kong 64 is finally here, and the team that pulled it off is proud to say that they used zero generative AI tools in the process.
body: DK64 Rekongpiled, a recompilation or translation of the game's code for modern hardware (as opposed to emulation), dropped today. All you need is an original Donkey Kong 64 ROM to get it running.
In a post on Bluesky (and also in the trailer ), contributor 2dos wrote that "no generative AI [was] used at any point in the process."

Everything in the original game is still there, including its old fuzzy 3D graphics, bouncy soundtrack, and the rest of the things that made Donkey Kong 64 an innovative and sometimes maddening game. It all runs at high resolutions and high framerates like any other modern PC game. You can even play with a mouse now, too.

The port is here just two months after a group of programmers decided to take the project on after seeing another group heavily use AI vibe code in the process. At the time, contributor 2dos wrote in the N64 Recomp Discord server that the competing project's use of AI would "make it progressively harder to manage as time goes on."
points: A native PC port of Nintendo's 1999 platformer Donkey Kong 64 is finally here, and the team that pulled it off is proud to say that they used zero generative AI tools in the process.

articles.title: Elden Ring players are hard at work putting the new Tarnished Edition DLC's gear to the test
articles.summary: Hand Elden Ring players a handful of new armor sets and weapons and they'll spend the next week or more experimenting and crunching the numbers to find out how they stack up against everything else in the legendary action RPG.
body: That is all that's been happening in the last few days since FromSoftware dropped the Tarnished Edition, a $5 DLC pack with new starting classes, armor sets, and horse armor.

It took a little while for people to figure out where to find everything added in the DLC. FromSoft did what FromSoft does and snuck them into places you wouldn't expect. But now that everyone feels like they've found it all, including some minor additions that weren't announced, the testing has begun.

By far the most popular new weapon is a greatsword you can steal from a new NPC who can show up for a duel. Leontiel's Greatsword is a direct reference to a character from Dark Souls 2 and comes with a powerful new move that mimics real life bullfighters, or matadors. When you use it, your character holds out a red cloth before stepping around your target and thrusting the sword into their back. It's easily one of the slickest animations in the game and, unsurprisingly, has players eager to see how it fairs against bosses.

articles.title: GTA 6's gameplay reveal pulled in 3.97 million peak viewers, overwhelming Twitch and Netflix in the process
articles.summary: Reaction streams to Grand Theft Auto 6 's first gameplay presentation peaked at 3,970,738 viewers across livestreaming platforms, making it the biggest gaming stream of 2026 so far.
body: That's according to new data from Streams Charts, which claims 9,038 streamers covered Rockstar Games ' Netflix reveal, racking up 5,227,798 hours watched.

That puts GTA 6's reveal ahead of Summer Game Fest 2026's 3.81 million peak viewers, as well as June's Nintendo Direct and State of Play broadcasts. Twitch carried the largest share of the audience, accounting for around 44 percent of total hours watched, ahead of YouTube (34.8% percent) and Kick (20.2 percent).
Spanish streamer Juan Alberto "IlloJuan" García led the way with 233,520 peak viewers, a new record for his own channel, ahead of Rubius (191,056) and IShowSpeed (177,887).

The reveal went out at 8pm UK time, but heavy demand caused technical issues on both Netflix and Twitch, with some viewers reportedly locked out for 40-50 minutes. That didn't deter internet hype, though; Streams Charts also tracked more than 100,000 chat messages about the game across the three-hour window it analysed.
points: Reaction streams to Grand Theft Auto 6 's first gameplay presentation peaked at 3,970,738 viewers across livestreaming platforms, making it the biggest gaming stream of 2026 so far.

points: Step through Gate Zero and journey to first century Judea and Galilee in this story-rich action-adventure that blends exciting combat, immersive exploration, player-driven narrative and biblical…
In the dystopian future of 2072, the authoritarian regime UniFi controls every piece of information, erasing anything that challenges its version of the truth.
When young scavenger Max accidentally activates a mysterious time machine while fleeing UniFi, he is thrust into ancient Israel at the time of Jesus.
Meet legendary biblical figures, witness pivotal moments firsthand, and uncover the extraordinary lengths UniFi will go to in order to rewrite history.
